correctness.rationale: The rational normalized map and its two-step square were explicitly differentiated. At every interior point of the neutral segment, the normal multiplier is \(u(1-u)\le1/4\) and the corrected tangent coefficient simplifies exactly to \((2u-1)^3/(u^2-u+1)\). Uniform Taylor remainders and a geometric contraction make the error summable across \(O(1/\varepsilon)\) two-step updates. The integrated ODE yields the inverse-square and logarithmic crossing law. The embedded `verify.py` performs exact rational checks and convergence experiments; the analysis is the actual proof. No boundary-uniform or near-midpoint-uniform claim is made.

value.rationale: When the critical parameter \(a/b\) vanishes, a continuum of neutral two-cycles appears, creating an intrinsic metastable selection problem. An explicit nonconstant cubic selection field, derived only after controlling the fast transverse response, and its exact exit-time law quantify the relaxation mechanism on the natural \(b/a\) scale. This adds meaningful long-time dynamical information beyond a basin classification or local multiplier sign.
